prompt_text:
Match this appearance phrase against ALL anonymous person tiles in the image(s): "the person with long red hair wearing a white crop top with black trim and black pants"
Every labeled tile is one different person from the same video; its two crops are held-out views. Labels and tile order do not reveal the intended target. A phrase may match none, one, or several people. Include ALL people who visibly satisfy the whole phrase in matches. Include in uncertain any plausible person for whom the views do not resolve an attribute, instead of assuming that person is a non-match. Do not pick a best match when several fit. A location or action does not distinguish appearance. Omitted labels mean clear non-matches.
Return {"matches":["P01"],"uncertain":[],"reason":"brief visual explanation"}. Valid labels: ["P01", "P02", "P03", "P04"].

message.content: {"matches":["P01","P04"],"uncertain":[],"reason":"P01 and P04 both have long red hair and are wearing a white crop top with black trim and black pants. P02 has dark hair and a black crop top, and P03 has dark hair and a black crop top, so they do not match the description."}

parsed.reason: P01 and P04 both have long red hair and are wearing a white crop top with black trim and black pants. P02 has dark hair and a black crop top, and P03 has dark hair and a black crop top, so they do not match the description.
